description: Melanotan I (afamelanotide) is a 13-amino-acid analogue of α-melanocyte-stimulating hormone designed for increased stability and MC1 receptor selectivity. It is used in receptor-pharmacology and pigment-cell research as a selective melanocortin-1 receptor (MC1R) agonist alongside the broader-spectrum, cyclic analogue Melanotan II.

faq.question: What is the difference between Melanotan I and Melanotan II?
faq.answer: Melanotan I (afamelanotide) is a linear 13-amino-acid α-MSH analogue with selectivity for MC1R. Melanotan II is a cyclic 7-amino-acid analogue with a broader melanocortin receptor profile (including MC3R/MC4R) in receptor research.
